title: Rooms — Changed — payload
description: One-way signal from a room's host to the address of an armed `rooms/watch`: the room has moved past the version the member had read to. The room and its latest version, and nothing about what changed. There is no #response form. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

roomId.description: The room the watch was armed on, exactly as the member named it.

latestVersion.description: The highest version the room had taken when the host sent the signal: the version a `rooms/records/list` with the member's watermark as `sinceVersion` would at least reach. A hint for the reader, who learns what changed only by listing.

ext.description: Ecosystem-defined extension members per SPEC.md §4.5.1. A host MUST NOT put anything here about what changed.
